contract.callback_mutation_isolation: A listener can add another listener during callback execution without aborting EventBus.emit()
contract.current_cycle_isolation: A listener added during an active broadcast does not receive that same broadcast
contract.post_add_continuity: The newly registered listener receives subsequent broadcasts
contract.delivery_once: Each currently registered listener receives the applicable broadcast exactly once
contract.registry_integrity: The listener registry remains structurally valid after callback-driven registration
contract.unique_owner_integrity: Callback-driven registration does not create duplicate owner entries
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful before and after callback-driven listener addition
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration and emit operations require the events permission
